quests.title: The Illumiscreen: II

dialogue.t: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.
Ah, it's you. You've come at a good time. I've changed to a new set of lanterns since the last time you were here.
Fancy giving it a try, seeing if you can solve this one? It won't be as easy as last time.

dialogue.sit: Why? Is the image more complex?
Is the lantern rotation more difficult?

dialogue.t: No, no. The image is easy to spot, and there are still only three parts to combine.
The difficulty this time has to do with the lantern rotation part.
Okay, so, the image to make today is <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora</color>. Remember, you have to get the right image first before you can go looking for the treasure.
The image to try and make today is <color=#00E1FFFF>Mora</color>.
You've solved it already? You're becoming very good at this very quickly. Go and study the image, there's a treasure clue hidden in it.
The treasure has all been prepared specially by the Guild. Happy hunting.
How is the treasure hunt going?
All of it? You're quite the expert treasure hunter, then... Plenty of people give up and walk off after the first try...
Since you found all the treasure... Please take these as your prize. Happy Lantern Rite!

quests.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers’ Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen…
